title: Disabling microphone through Audio Volume popup does not allow you to enable it with a keyboard mic mute shortcut
line: The microphone mute key now unmutes a microphone that was muted from the Audio Volume popup.
explanation: Since Plasma 6.5 the microphone mute shortcut only toggles a global mute layered on top of each device's own mute. If the default microphone was already muted from the applet, the first press turned the global mute on (the mic stayed muted) and the next press lifted only the global mute, which never touches devices it did not mute itself, so the microphone could not be unmuted from the keyboard. The shortcut now checks the preferred microphone: if it is muted (or the global mute is on), it lifts the global mute and unmutes that microphone; otherwise it applies the global mute as before. Other microphones the user muted explicitly stay muted.

commits.message:
kded: Unmute the default microphone with the mute shortcut when muted

When the microphone had been muted in the applet, the mute shortcut only
toggled the global mute on top of it, so the microphone stayed muted no
matter how often it was pressed. Now the shortcut unmutes it instead.

BUG: 511276

media.caption: Before: pressing the microphone mute key shows "Microphone Muted" and the microphone stays muted
After: pressing the microphone mute key unmutes it (OSD at 100%, popup button shows unmuted)
